Title: AMB-FR-001 — Canonical root shell and app chrome integrity
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-A — Shell & IA Lock

Problem:
Root shell expectations and rendered shell affordances are not fully aligned.

Implementation:
Create one canonical shell path for tab host, contextual header rail, continuity ribbon, global capture entry, overlay host, safe-area behavior, accessibility identifiers, and UI smoke tests.

Rollback:
Keep prior TabView shell as a temporary compatibility fallback until tests pass.
Acceptance gate: All five tabs render through one canonical shell path and shell UI tests pass.
Validation: xcodegen generate; xcodebuild test -scheme Ambitions -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'; scripts/validate_flagship_remediation.sh

Title: AMB-FR-002 — Slice AppContainer into bounded capabilities
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-A — Shell & IA Lock

Problem:
The app container is too dense and risks becoming a service locator.

Implementation:
Split capabilities into shell, runtime, persistence, platform, user system, and feature factory slices. Feature screens should receive only the required slice.

Rollback:
Keep AppContainer as a facade delegating to sliced capabilities.
Acceptance gate: Feature construction is inspectable and no screen imports the full global container unnecessarily.
Validation: Build, dependency review artifact, affected feature tests.

Title: AMB-FR-003 — Retire active legacy IA route seams
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-A — Shell & IA Lock

Problem:
Legacy route language can leak into active product routes and weaken canonical IA clarity.

Implementation:
Move legacy route compatibility into documented boundary adapters only. Active APIs must use Today, Goals, Capture, Time, and You.

Rollback:
Preserve hidden deep-link compatibility mappings.
Acceptance gate: No active user-facing route or app intent exposes deprecated top-level object names except hidden compatibility shims.
Validation: Canon grep/lint, navigation tests, App Intent route tests.

Title: AMB-FR-004 — Shell visual QA and preview matrix
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-A — Shell & IA Lock

Problem:
Shell polish needs device-visible proof across sizes, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and dark/OLED states.

Implementation:
Add preview matrices and screenshot hooks for all top-level tabs and major shell states.

Rollback:
Keep preview data isolated from production models.
Acceptance gate: Each tab has preview coverage and screenshot proof path.
Validation: Preview compile, UI screenshot smoke, proof artifact.

Title: AMB-FR-005 — Decontaminate life-context domain fixtures
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-B — Local Data Foundation

Problem:
Domain fixtures may contain off-domain or stale scenario vocabulary.

Implementation:
Replace non-Ambitions fixtures with neutral, privacy-safe Ambitions-native personas. Remove obsolete enum references and fixture bleed.

Rollback:
Archive old fixtures only in docs, never active source.
Acceptance gate: No off-domain fixture vocabulary remains in compiled domain source.
Validation: Build, fixture lint, runtime scenario tests.

Title: AMB-FR-006 — SwiftData temporal and enum type-safety pass
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-B — Local Data Foundation

Problem:
Persistence can become fragile if dates, states, and enums rely on raw strings.

Implementation:
Convert persisted temporal fields to Date where appropriate and isolate raw enum storage to tested adapters.

Rollback:
Add v1-to-v2 migration adapters and backup export path.
Acceptance gate: Core persisted entities no longer depend on ad hoc string ordering.
Validation: Migration harness, repository round-trip tests, deterministic ordering tests.

Title: AMB-FR-007 — Normalize persistence away from blob-first reads
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-B — Local Data Foundation

Problem:
Snapshot blobs should not be the ordinary read path for key product objects.

Implementation:
Normalize primary fields for goals, steps, receipts, context, closure, recovery, and time placement. Keep snapshots for audit/export boundaries.

Rollback:
Maintain snapshot fallback for one migration cycle.
Acceptance gate: Today, Goals, Time, and You reads do not require decoding whole object snapshots.
Validation: Repository query tests, performance baseline, storage comparison.

Title: AMB-FR-008 — Explicit schema migration and store recovery system
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-B — Local Data Foundation

Problem:
The store needs explicit migration, recovery, corruption handling, and proof artifacts.

Implementation:
Add schema versioning, migration plans, seeded historical stores, corruption handling, recovery mode, and migration receipts.

Rollback:
Export backup before migration and support explicit safe reset.
Acceptance gate: Every persisted model revision has a tested upgrade path.
Validation: Migration matrix, seeded old-store upgrade tests, corrupt-store simulation.

Title: AMB-FR-009 — Repository query performance and deterministic ordering gates
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-B — Local Data Foundation

Problem:
Core local reads need reliable ordering and bounded query work.

Implementation:
Add deterministic sorting, query limits, large fixtures, and budget gates for repository calls.

Rollback:
Keep old repository methods as deprecated internal helpers.
Acceptance gate: Core repository reads have deterministic ordering and measured budgets.
Validation: Repository benchmark tests and deterministic result snapshots.

Title: AMB-FR-010 — Structured life context and Memory Lens data basis
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-B — Local Data Foundation

Problem:
You and Memory Lens need structured, editable, provenance-aware local data.

Implementation:
Back memory/profile/life-context display with structured local records, provenance, confidence, edit/reset controls, and privacy-safe indexing.

Rollback:
Keep projected summaries as display fallback.
Acceptance gate: User can inspect, edit, reset, and understand local life-context records.
Validation: You feature tests, reset tests, provenance rendering tests, privacy redaction tests.

Title: AMB-FR-011 — Same-intent different-context runtime proof harness
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-C — Private Life Runtime Proof

Problem:
The core moat must be proven in code, not just docs.

Implementation:
Create fixtures with same goal/intent but different local contexts and assert deterministically different Start here outputs with receipts.

Rollback:
Keep existing Today selection logic as fallback.
Acceptance gate: Executable proof shows different recommended steps from different local contexts.
Validation: Runtime proof tests, explanation diff artifact, replay artifact.

Title: AMB-FR-012 — Deterministic planner rule-engine upgrade
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-C — Private Life Runtime Proof

Problem:
Planning heuristics need to be deeper than lexical or shallow priority matching.

Implementation:
Build inspectable local rules using context vectors, user defaults, closure evidence, time fit, confidence, fallback reasons, and deterministic traces.

Rollback:
Keep current planner as deterministic fallback.
Acceptance gate: Planner output is local, deterministic, inspectable, and context-aware.
Validation: Golden plan tests, edge-case fixtures, no-network assertion, explanation trace tests.

Title: AMB-FR-013 — Today runtime replay and receipt inspector
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-C — Private Life Runtime Proof

Problem:
Start here recommendations need inspectable proof and replay evidence.

Implementation:
Add receipt/proof drawer with inputs, freshness, local-only source boundaries, time fit, alternatives rejected, and closure/recovery effects.

Rollback:
Expose inspector behind internal flag until stable.
Acceptance gate: Every Start here recommendation has inspectable proof and replay test coverage.
Validation: Today UI tests, runtime replay tests, receipt snapshot tests.

Title: AMB-FR-014 — User correction loop for runtime trust
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-C — Private Life Runtime Proof

Problem:
A personal life OS needs corrections that change future behavior without cloud dependence.

Implementation:
Add correction flows for wrong reason, wrong context, wrong capacity, unavailable, still counts, blocked, waiting, and recovery needed.

Rollback:
Persist corrections separately until behavior is proven.
Acceptance gate: Corrections change future local recommendations and generate receipts.
Validation: Correction loop tests, no-network tests, accessibility flow tests.

Title: AMB-FR-015 — Deep App Intents action surface
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-D — Apple Platform Depth

Problem:
App Intents should do more than open routes.

Implementation:
Add parameterized intents for capture, goal draft, open current step, start current step, guarded close step, show receipt, and inspect local knowledge.

Rollback:
Disable public shortcut exposure until safety review passes.
Acceptance gate: Shortcuts can perform meaningful Ambitions-native actions with safety boundaries.
Validation: App Intent tests, phrase review, route execution tests.

Title: AMB-FR-016 — Spotlight and Handoff object reopening
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-D — Apple Platform Depth

Problem:
Search and Handoff strategy should be implemented with privacy boundaries.

Implementation:
Index safe summaries for goals, current step, receipts, and captures. Add Handoff reopening for active step and goal detail.

Rollback:
Gate indexing behind opt-in/internal flag.
Acceptance gate: Apple-native reopening works without leaking sensitive private content.
Validation: Indexing tests, redaction tests, Handoff route tests.

Title: AMB-FR-017 — Optional CloudKit continuity decision gate
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-D — Apple Platform Depth

Problem:
Continuity matters, but it cannot compromise local-first trust or launch stability.

Implementation:
Create a decision gate for optional CloudKit with schema, conflict model, opt-in UX, off switch, privacy copy, and proof tests.

Rollback:
Keep launch local-only if proof is not green.
Acceptance gate: No sync implementation proceeds without signed-off privacy and migration strategy.
Validation: Architecture decision record, sync fixture plan, privacy review packet.

Title: AMB-FR-018 — Background maintenance and notification reconciliation
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-D — Apple Platform Depth

Problem:
The app needs coherent state after relaunch, day rollover, stale notifications, and interrupted sessions.

Implementation:
Add background-safe reconciliation for day maintenance, notification schedule refresh, stale-step closure prompts, and receipt freshness.

Rollback:
Gate background writes until read-only reconciliation is proven.
Acceptance gate: Relaunch and day transitions preserve coherent Today state.
Validation: Clock travel tests, notification reconciliation tests, lifecycle UI tests.

Title: AMB-FR-019 — Widget and Live Activity flagship expansion
Description:
Severity: Medium
Train: T-D — Apple Platform Depth

Problem:
External surfaces should feel like native Ambitions extensions, not demos.

Implementation:
Expand widget families for current step, Today pressure, protected time, capture entry, and recovery state. Add Live Activity proof where appropriate.

Rollback:
Keep existing Next Step widget baseline.
Acceptance gate: Widgets and Live Activity states are Ambitions-native and validated.
Validation: Widget snapshots, ActivityKit update tests, lock screen review.

Title: AMB-FR-020 — Accessibility proof matrix and gates
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-E — Trust, Accessibility, Release Lock

Problem:
Accessibility needs device-backed proof across real surfaces.

Implementation:
Create proof matrix for VoiceOver labels/order, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast, tap targets, non-color meaning, and cognitive clarity.

Rollback:
Block release if any P0 accessibility gate is red.
Acceptance gate: Accessibility status is evidence-backed for all five tabs and key flows.
Validation: Accessibility UI tests, manual audit packet, screenshot proof.

Title: AMB-FR-021 — Device-truth QA and release candidate packet
Description:
Severity: Critical
Train: T-E — Trust, Accessibility, Release Lock

Problem:
Readiness proof must come from device and binary behavior.

Implementation:
Create an RC packet requiring build output, simulator/device matrix, screenshots, accessibility evidence, migration proof, privacy manifest proof, and known limitation log.

Rollback:
Release remains blocked until packet is green.
Acceptance gate: No release can be green without device-backed evidence.
Validation: RC packet, UI tests, migration tests.

Title: AMB-FR-022 — Privacy manifest and App Store declaration alignment
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-E — Trust, Accessibility, Release Lock

Problem:
Privacy claims must match binary behavior, permissions, logs, indexing, and continuity choices.

Implementation:
Audit permissions, network calls, logs, indexing, analytics/crash behavior, export/sync behavior, and generate privacy readiness artifact.

Rollback:
Remove or gate any feature that cannot be honestly declared.
Acceptance gate: App Store privacy claims, privacy manifest, and code behavior are consistent.
Validation: Privacy lint, no-network runtime test, manifest review.

Title: AMB-FR-023 — Local observability and performance baselines
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-E — Trust, Accessibility, Release Lock

Problem:
A local-first flagship needs measurable performance without leaking private data.

Implementation:
Add local redacted logging, launch-time budget, repository query budget, runtime projection budget, and local diagnostic export.

Rollback:
Diagnostics disabled by default until privacy review passes.
Acceptance gate: Performance and diagnostics proof exists without private analytics collection.
Validation: Performance baseline script, log redaction tests, launch budget artifact.

Title: AMB-FR-024 — Repo authority collapse and Codex automation manifest
Description:
Severity: High
Train: T-E — Trust, Accessibility, Release Lock

Problem:
Repo governance is strong but heavy; Codex needs fewer sharper authority paths.

Implementation:
Create authority map, stale-doc detector, active batch manifest, train runner instructions, and Green/Yellow/Red proof reporting.

Rollback:
Never delete historical docs without archiving or explicit stale classification.
Acceptance gate: Codex can identify source truth, batch order, validation commands, proof artifacts, and rollback behavior.
Validation: Authority lint, stale-doc scan, manifest validation script.
